verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents ClickUp's own dashboards or widgets. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: a third-party analytics integration in the directory (intdir-17) and AI assistants generating executive reports via MCP (docs-40). Neither is a first-party dashboard or widget builder for project-progress reporting.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress
